localChanges: chore: lock the merged engine packages that add Explore and Automate

log: Two `Action` rules, after all the existing ones so their order is unchanged: `explore` for land units that are `Fortifiable` (Diplomats and Caravans included) and ships, never Settlers or aircraft; `automate` for `Worker`s. Both need moves left and act on the unit's own tile. They're built with the game's `StrategyRegistry`, a new last argument of `Rules/Unit/action`'s `getRules` (passed `game.strategies` by `registerRules`), and offered whether or not the game has the strategy: without it the order hands the unit straight back. See civ-clone/web-renderer#198 and #200. Needs library-unit 0.1.10.

Re-exports the `Explore` and `Automate` unit actions from the new `base-unit-action-explore` and `base-unit-action-automate` packages, the standing orders for a unit to explore and for a worker to improve the terrain by itself (civ-clone/web-renderer#198, #200).

The generic AI toolkit (Dependencies, Knowledge, Memory, MemoryRegistry, actionLookup, the survey, the unit turn context, orders, reachable, AIStrategy, isUnitAction, unitTurnContextFor, and Mission / nearest / pursue) is now @civ-clone/base-strategy-ai; exploreLand / exploreSea and the exploring terms of the move score are @civ-clone/base-strategy-explore; the terrain jobs and the TerrainWork strategy are @civ-clone/base-strategy-terrain-work (civ-clone/web-renderer#198, #200).

scoreUnitMove is rebuilt from base-strategy-explore's terms, added in the same order, so every score is the same float, and it asks for the unit's actions the same once. TerrainWork is given travelToPathEnd, the moveUnit call terrainWork made itself. Explore is registered last and handles no action, so the order the computer players' strategies run in is unchanged. registerStrategies still exports dependenciesFor and createStrategies. UncalmedReason and MartialLawPolicy are re-exported from where they were.
No change in play: the conformance game is identical over 150 turns, and the arena's 20 games against eedaa38 differ by exactly 0 in every metric.
chore: declare core-data-object, which the tests import
